business_purpose: Calculate the final total cost of the shopping cart including line item totals, shipping costs, sales tax, and applicable order adjustments.
mathematical_formula: GrandTotal = SubTotal + TotalShipping + TotalSalesTax + OrderOtherAdjustmentTotal + OrderGlobalAdjustments

sub_total.description: Sum of subtotals for all individual line items in the cart.

total_shipping.description: Sum of shipping estimates across all ship groups.

total_sales_tax.description: Sum of sales tax calculated for each ship group.

order_other_adjustment_total.description: Calculated total of non-shipping and non-tax order-level adjustments applied to the cart subtotal.

order_global_adjustments.description: Calculated total of global order adjustments that are not tied to a specific ship group (or shipGroupSeqId is '_NA_').

database_targets.purpose: Source of global and line-item level adjustments, taxes, and shipping charges.
Source of line-item base pricing and quantities used in subtotal calculation.
Source of ship-group level shipping estimates and associated tax adjustments.
